reported.title: Presses near the 20 ms settle threshold are missed
reported.description: The debounce in scanStart() only accepts a press once the raw level has been stable for SETTLE_MS (20 ms), and the check at line 46 uses `now - rawChangedAt >= SETTLE_MS` with rawChangedAt updated only when the sampled level changes (lines 41-45). Because the loop samples asynchronously, a press lasting about 18-22 ms can be released before a stable 20 ms window is ever observed, so openZone() at line 51 is never called; the engine measured "D10 missed 3 of 5 trigger(s): D10 did not start within 100 ms of the trigger at 500 ms" (also at 2.00 s and 4.00 s). The settle window is too close to the bounce/press duration, so legitimate presses are filtered out instead of only bounce being rejected. D10 missed 3 of 5 trigger(s): D10 did not start within 100 ms of the trigger at 500 ms.

judge_input.spec:
- Zone valve relay on D10; start button on D6 with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- A settled press on D6 opens the valve (D10 HIGH) for 500 ms, starting within 100 ms of the press.
- Contact bounce up to 12 ms on press and release must not start a second burst.
- Presses while the valve is open are ignored and do not extend it.
- The valve stays closed (D10 LOW) whenever no press has been accepted.
- Print `zone n=<count>` every 1000 ms.
